priority_failure_modes.rationale: Reject evidence logic that permits patient overlap, target-derived information, future-state information, or any oracle signal to enter design, training, selection, or evaluation paths, because such access destroys causal interpretability.
The review is design-only: any statement implying completed execution, observed performance, empirical readiness, or statistical support without runtime evidence violates the frozen truth boundary.

A credible first-paper plan must bind manifests, seeds, artifacts, failure gates, resource assumptions, and non-LLM execution receipts tightly enough that later results can be distinguished from invented or untraceable outputs.

Any scope expansion, illegal operation-target-scope combination, or reinterpretation outside operation={ADD,REMOVE}, target={SAME,NEW}, scope={LOCAL,COMPLETE} and the six frozen legal joints changes the scientific question rather than testing it.

rejection_conditions: Reject a candidate if any patient-level leakage, oracle access, target-derived shortcut, or unverifiable split isolation is present or left materially uncontrolled.
Reject a candidate if it claims or implies executed experiments, observed results, statistical evidence, novelty, or readiness beyond the authorized DESIGN_ONLY state.

Reject a candidate if its proposed execution cannot produce traceable manifests, seeds, raw-output bindings, failure-gate records, and independent executor receipts sufficient to audit result provenance.
Reject a candidate if it violates the frozen six-joint ontology, changes the dataset or patient-level split boundary, or broadens first-paper scope beyond the stated research question.
Reject a candidate if any of Q1, Q3, Q4, or Q6 scores below 3, or if any fatal defect is identified.

score_policy.winner_rule: Score Q1-Q8 independently on the frozen 0-4 scale. A candidate is ineligible if it has any fatal defect or any core score below 3. Among eligible candidates, select the higher unweighted Q1-Q8 total; break a tie by Q4, then Q6, then Q8, then Q5, and declare no unique winner if the tie remains.
